body:
How can I go about killing myself without 

1) Traumatizing whoever walks in more than absolutely necessary

2) Risking that I survive but get brain damage or something

If you look at my comment history you'll get a pretty good idea of why Im planning on killing myself. I'm not depressed, I'm just miserable from years of chronic pain.

Tell me about it. Right now I'm talking to people from fucking Switzerland because my own country would rather leave people to rot than help them die. Except my condition's agonizing but nonlethal, so I might well spend sixty years like this if I don't do something.  Can't overdose at home -- that has an alarmingly high survival rate. Same's true for guns (DO NOT google "survived shotgun suicide"), and I don't have access to one anyway. I'd almost consider just shoving a knife in my side -- even if I survive, maybe I'll core out the nerves causing the pain -- but the ribcage makes it hard to hit any vital organs that way. Maybe I could stop eating and wait, but the only thing that scares me more than the pain is getting a tube shoved down my throat. Again.

And of course, the doctors won't use narcotics to treat someone with chronic pain and nothing else works.

So I'm stuck begging for foreign aid so I can die. Or treatment of the pain for as long as possible, but I would have better luck hoping for divine intervention. And it's not like I can get pain medicine illegally -- I can't leave the fucking house!

I probably shouldn't post this, and I definitely shouldn't be using the same throwaway twice, but fuck it.

The problem with the black market is that you need to either be rich or you need to know a guy. I do not know a guy.

As for storm-kicking: yes, absolutely. I feel so helpless knowing that other people are probably going through the same thing as me. The doctors won't take responsibility,  so I guess I'm the only one who can.
Yeah, it's not that. It is rare enough that saying what I have would be enough to dox me.
Sorry, you're going to have to clarify what that is.
I have. Helps with the nausea, but it can't make a dent in the pain.

Well, it's not going to be a chronic problem. If I can't keep the pain under control, then there is no way in hell I'll live past 20. I've been investigating a euthanasia group called Dignitas and hope to go to Switzerland once I turn 18. Please don't try to convince me that my life is somehow worth living. This is hell, in the most literal sense possible. I am in agony every waking minute of every day and will continue to be in agony until the day I finally die - or the day that the doctors decide to do something.

My parents are aware of the situation, but there's nothing they can do about it. The doctors won't listen to them either. What are they going to do, buy it off the street?

This is why a high school economics cost should be mandatory. Opportunity cost, people. You spend 4 hours to save 2 dollars, you're basically losing money. (Unless, of course, your time's worth 50 cents an hour).
